model_annotation: This plot represents the coverage of a certain parameter or variable as a function of the number of completions. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a linear scale, showing a range from 20 to 256. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" with values ranging approximately from 0.3 to 0.9. There are four lines in the plot, each representing different conditions or methods: "Llama-3B" is shown with blue circles and a solid line, "Llama-1B" with light blue circles and a dashed line, "Llama-1B + FT" with green triangles and a dotted dash-dot line, and an unlabeled line with green triangles and a dashed line that the legend does not clarify. All lines generally show an increase in coverage as the number of completions increases. The "Llama-3B" line shows the highest coverage, reaching values close to 0.9 at 256 completions. The "Llama-1B" line shows a slower increase in coverage, starting just above 0.3 and reaching around 0.6. The "Llama-1B + FT" line shows the least increase, starting just above 0.3 and leveling off near 0.7. The unlabeled line also shows an increase but is close to the "Llama-1B + FT" line, starting around 0.4 and reaching approximately 0.7.
